correctness.rationale: For n>=7 the column-square clique restriction forces a unique distance-two outer-edge pair in every nonlocal face; each such edge has a three-vertex simplex link. Four explicitly ordered free-face pairs per edge yield exactly 20n simplicial collapses to a cyclic cover by ten-vertex slabs. A 48-pair certified collapse reduces each slab to a six-vertex eight-triangle closed surface with Euler characteristic two and four-cycle vertex links: S2. The graph-of-spaces homotopy colimit with n spherical vertex spaces, n contractible overlaps and cycle incidence graph yields S1 wedge n S2. The scale-one first-homology statement follows from the surviving row-fixed cycle. The finite Python verifier reconstructs all faces and independently validates the free-face operations for n=7..12, but the all-parameter proof is symbolic.
